inventory.notes: Fix of a 157 priority inversion (commit 044fdc985f): StartupCache writes no longer take nsAutoLowPriorityIO, whose THREAD_MODE_BACKGROUND_BEGIN starved the writer while it held mTableLock and so the main thread in GetBuffer() (7-27 s stalls with eleven browsers). 151 had no lowered priority here.
